title: Shriek Control
description: A Minecraft mod that gives players full control over which mobs spawn from a Sculk Shrieker. Customize encounters, fine-tune the danger lurking in the Deep Dark.
body:
Shriek Control lets you decide exactly what happens when a Sculk Shrieker is activated. Instead of the default behavior, you can configure which monsters spawn, making the Deep Dark more customizable, chaotic, or strategic than ever before.

You can also decide wether entities spawn with potion effects as a bonus (this feature was added to make the mod compatible with [Corrosive Sculk](https://modrinth.com/mod/corrosive-sculk) by [Hipposgrumm](https://modrinth.com/user/Hipposgrumm))

Create terrifying custom encounters, build adventure maps with controlled mob events, or simply add variety to your survival world. Whether you want waves of Creepers, armies of Skeletons, or completely randomized horror, Shriek Control puts the power in your hands.

Features
- Choose which mobs spawn from Sculk Shriekers
- Fully configurable spawn lists
- Supports vanilla and modded mobs
- Perfect for adventure maps and custom survival gameplay
- Easy balancing for multiplayer servers
- Configure if you want mobs to spawn with potion effects
